title: 疑问句的应答
goal: 按疑问句所需的信息选择回应，并由间接回答判断事实是否成立。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 根据疑问词选出给出对应信息的回应
识别不带 yes / no 的间接回答

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 回应疑问句，要给出所问的信息，或者说明所问的事是否属实。疑问词决定要哪一类信息，时态决定说的是什么时候。有 yes 或 no 的选项不一定对。

body.box:
How often is the filter changed? → Every month.
Has the filter been changed? → The technician hasn't done it yet.

body.p: 第一句问频率，回应是每月一次。第二句问这次换了没有，回应是还没换。两个回应互换就答非所问。

steps.d: 听疑问词和后面的名词或动作。How long 问时长，How often 问频率。How long does the journey take? 要答路上用多久。
把否定疑问句和反意疑问句还原成要核实的事。Isn’t the gate locked? 核实门锁没锁：It is 是锁了，It isn’t 是没锁。
把选项里的状态或理由换成直接的回答。Has the package arrived? 后接 It’s still at the depot，意思是还没到，不用出现 no。

cards.title: 疑问词与信息
rows: who / whose
who 问人，whose 问东西是谁的。
Who booked the van? → Marta did. / Whose van is it? → Marta's.
where / when
where 问地点，when 问时间。
Where is the reception? → On the terrace. / When? → At six.
why
问原因。Why don’t we 是提议，不是问原因。
Why was the route closed? → A bridge needed repairs.
how
问方式或状态，看后面的动词。
How was the equipment delivered? → By truck.
how long / how often
how long 问多长时间，how often 问多久一次。
How long? → For an hour. / How often? → Once a month.
how many / how much
how many 问可数的数量，how much 问价钱或不可数的量。
How many jars? → Six. / How much does one cost? → Two dollars.
which / or
从给出的几项中选一项，不能只答 yes。
Which route, coastal or inland? → The inland route.

cards.title: 确认与间接回答
rows: 一般疑问句
说出状态，就能推出是或否，可以不说 yes / no。
Is the lift working? → It's being repaired.
完成时疑问句
already、still、yet 说明做完了没有。
Have the badges arrived? → They're on the desk already.
否定疑问：肯定
yes 加肯定分句，表示事实成立。
Isn't the door open? → Yes, it is.
否定疑问：否定
no 后的否定分句说明事实不成立。
Isn't the door open? → No, it's locked.
反意疑问：肯定
按前面陈述部分的事实回答，不看附加问句里的否定。
The van has arrived, hasn't it? → It has; it's outside.
反意疑问：否定
说出相反的状态就是否定，不必说 no。
The van has arrived, hasn't it? → It's still on the motorway.
选择疑问句
选其中一项，也可以说哪个都行或都不要。
Tea or juice? → Either is fine.

body.box: Haven't they finished restoring the old fountain?

Choose the best response.
1. The fountain was built a century ago.
2. They finished a different fountain last spring.
3. They're still replacing the stone around its base.
4. Sure, I'll ask them to finish it today.

body.p: Haven’t they finished 是核实修复完成了没有。第三项的 still replacing 说明还在施工，间接回答了还没修完。
第一项谈年代，第二项把对象换成另一座喷泉，第四项把问句当成了请求。这三项都没有说明这座喷泉现在修到了哪一步。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 信息类别不符
How often? → For three weeks.
for three weeks 是时长，不是频率。
时间不符
When will it open? → It opened last year.
问将来，不答过去。
否定范围错误
Isn't it ready? → Yes, it is. 被理解为未就绪。
Yes, it is 表示已经好了。
对象替换
the old fountain → a different fountain
核对是不是同一对象。
只答字面
Do you know where it is? → I know.
间接问句里有 where，仍要答地点。

lines.text: Whose gloves were left beside the kiln?

options: Yes, I'll take them to her.
They belong to the visiting artist.
The gloves were left yesterday.
They're made for handling hot objects.
items.why: Whose gloves 问手套是谁的，第二项答是来访的艺术家的。第三项答的是什么时候留下的。

lines.text: How often does the ferry stop at this island?

options: The trip takes an hour.
The island has two docks.
The ferry is stopping now.
Twice each morning.
items.why: How often 问多久停一次，第四项答每天上午两次。第一项的一小时是时长，不是频率。

lines.text: Why was the bread delivery delayed?

options: The delivery van had a flat tire.
The bread is delivered at dawn.
Yes, it was delayed by about an hour.
Sure, I'll deliver it myself.
items.why: Why 问为什么晚了，第一项给出原因：送货车爆胎。第三项只说晚了多久，没有说原因。

lines.text: Would you prefer the red ribbon or the gold one?

options: Yes, I'd prefer one of them.
The gold ribbon costs less.
The gold one would suit the package.
Thanks, I chose the red one last time.
items.why: red ribbon or the gold one 要求二选一，第三项选了金色，理由是和包裹相配。第二项只说价钱，没有作选择。

lines.text: Has the aquarium opened its new entrance yet?

options: The entrance faces the park.
Yes, I opened it for them this morning.
They're still putting the doors in.
The aquarium opened years ago.
items.why: Has … opened … yet 问新入口开了没有。第三项说门还在装，间接回答了还没开。第四项说的是整个水族馆，不是新入口。

lines.text: Isn't the bakery closed on Mondays?

options: It is; Monday is the staff's day off.
It opens early on Tuesdays.
No thanks, I've already had breakfast.
Yes, I closed it last Monday.
items.why: It is 是 It is closed 的省略，day off 说明周一确实不开门，即第一项。

lines.text: The canoe rental includes paddles, doesn't it?

options: The paddles are made of wood.
No, I rented it last summer.
Sure, I'll book a canoe and paddles for you.
There's a separate charge for those.
items.why: a separate charge for those 说明船桨要另外收费，间接回答了不包括，即第四项。

lines.text: Is the sound technician coming this evening?

options: The evening show starts at eight.
She has another job booked tonight.
Sure, I'll come over to help this evening.
The technician came last Tuesday.
items.why: another job booked tonight 说明她今晚另有工作，间接回答了不来，即第二项。第四项说的是过去。

lines.text: When does the costume fitting begin?

options: In the wardrobe room.
With the costume designer.
At half past two.
For about half an hour.
items.why: When 问几点开始，第三项给出时间。其余三项分别答了地点、和谁一起、多长时间。

lines.text: How long will the engine inspection take?

options: Roughly forty minutes.
Every six months.
At nine tomorrow.
In the service garage.
items.why: How long 问检查要多久，第一项答大约 40 分钟。第二项的每六个月一次是频率。

lines.text: Who should receive the signed witness form?

options: Before the hearing starts.
The clerk handling the case.
At the public entrance.
With the original signature.
items.why: Who should receive 问交给谁，第二项答负责此案的书记员。其余三项分别答了期限、地点和形式。

lines.text: Do you want the portrait framed in wood or metal?

options: Yes, I'd like it framed, please.
Thanks, I framed it myself last year.
The metal frame arrived today.
Wood would match the portrait better.
items.why: wood or metal 要求选一种材料，第四项选了木框。第一项只答了 yes，没有作选择。

lines.text: Have the new tennis nets been installed?

options: Sure, I'll install them for you.
Yes, I played tennis there yesterday.
The installer hasn't been here yet.
The nets were ordered locally.
items.why: hasn't been here yet 说明安装工人还没来，间接回答了网还没装，即第三项。

lines.text: Doesn't the cobbler accept card payments?

options: He only takes cash.
Thanks, I'll pay by card then.
No, I don't have a card.
The card machine was expensive.
items.why: only takes cash 说明只收现金，间接回答了不能刷卡，即第一项。

lines.text: The film subtitles are ready, aren't they?

options: The subtitles appear at the bottom.
Yes, I'll read them for you.
Sure, I'd love to watch the film with you tonight.
The translator is still correcting them.
items.why: still correcting them 说明字幕还在改，间接回答了还没好，即第四项。

lines.text: Haven't the violin strings been replaced?

options: The violin needs a new case.
They have; I changed them this morning.
I usually replace them myself.
Thanks, I'll play it for you later.
items.why: They have 是 They have been replaced 的省略，this morning 说明今早已换好，即第二项。第三项只说了平时的习惯。
